text: I'm into a bit of everything, but mainly indie and pop. I tend to put on music when I'm commuting, as it makes the journey far more bearable.

text: Not as often as I used to, to be honest. Streaming is just so convenient, although I still think a big screen makes a real difference for action films.

tips.en: This hedge sounds natural and shows you are weighing your opinion rather than reciting an answer (Fluency and Coherence).

tips.en: A contrast builds a complex sentence and shows balanced thinking (Grammatical Range).
